snippet.title: The Great Beyond Teaser
snippet.description:
Dig! Defend! Develop! The choices you make in this RTS game are critical.

Build utilities, worker amenities, living quarters, and production factories to keep your economy flowing. Then, prepare for the onslaught of enemies by building towers, hiring and training Battle Engineers, and managing your energy and ammo reserves. But, not all missions are the same!

Check out the store page! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4511850/The_Great_Beyond/
